verdict.rationale: Token2's official open-source fido2-manage CLI can dump device info and relying parties to JSON or CSV for audit/export, and it lists resident credentials, so an agent can read key state programmatically. However, the evidence never says the device-info dump includes serial number, firmware version, or enabled applications (PIV/OTP), and fleet-wide aggregation is not documented. Missing for 10: explicit serial/firmware fields in the export, enabled-application (PIV/OTP) state reporting, fleet-scale multi-key audit workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read a key's state programmatically — serial, firmware version, enabled applications, stored credentials — to audit security posture across a fleet

citations.quote: Audit/export: dump device info + relying parties to JSON or CSV
Resident credentials (passkeys): list (with user handle), delete, edit metadata
providing command-line tools and an optional graphical interface for advanced key management operations
It provides functionalities to view information, manage relying parties, and perform various operations on connected FIDO2.1 devices.
